read_input.returns: approved UTF-8 text and source hash; images and binary inputs are forbidden

arguments.topic: approved curriculum unit or reference page ID

read_docs.returns: frozen own-language documentation and paired example references; no historical target answers

arguments.symbols: entry:TASK_ID, index:OFFSET:LIMIT, file:RELATIVE_PATH, accepted_prefix, submission_gate, or receipt:check-NNNN or retry_stats

read_library.returns: Own-language frozen library index (paged), requested increments and interfaces, current journal and requested receipts; no other language artifacts

arguments.content: Complete new task candidate including helpers in whole_task mode; one logical fragment only for historical tracked_fragments jobs.
arguments.base: optional none (default), library, or accepted; prepend immutable source locally
arguments.item_id: Optional: controller automatically assigns TASK_ID:main in whole_task mode.
arguments.item_kind: definition, proof, or Lean scope; metadata persists on repairs

arguments.path: relative increment fragment for incremental; complete module entry for final

check.returns: Common receipt and complete native feedback with task_rounds; one incremental whole-task submission uses a round, final checks do not.

remaining_budget.returns: task_rounds current attempt window plus full history; candidates and network/API failures share five attempts; nullable time/check limits mean unlimited.

submit.returns: received after in-budget declaration/axiom gate or rejected; source-fidelity review remains separate

adapter_invariants: Tools enforce read/write boundaries; a prompt prohibition alone is insufficient.
Retain native language-specific diagnostics and state fields; common tool names do not imply identical native response schemas.
Ordinary failures retain native context; restarts replay every accepted source block and stop on any replay failure. No silent whole-file fallback.
Final checking uses a fresh process without replacing the persistent writing session. Session exit summaries are not per-candidate responses.
Final receipt binds the actual files, dependency manifests and verifier version; source edits invalidate it.
Agent has no ability to change verifier flags, the clock, usage records or evaluator decisions.
No external helper models in solver tools; any future nested model calls require explicit accounting and a separately frozen policy.
natural_language: English for task instructions, tools, prompts, guides, comments and submissions

checkpoint_recovery.all_five_api_failures: stop and retain current task; explicit restart opens a new window, retaining full history
checkpoint_recovery.duplicate_completed_tools: restore saved result without repeating side effects
